AudioData.Text: Hi! Welcome to the Air Cooler User Guide. To get started, please plug the air cooler into a power outlet. Press NEXT when you're ready to continue.

AudioData.ResourcesPath: At the front of the cooler, you can see the air vents.  Air flows out through these vents into the room.

AudioData.Text: Moving onto Step 2. When you plug the cooler, Inside the cooler, a motor spins the fan.
As the fan spins, it pushes air through the cooler and out of the front vents.  This creates a steady flow of air into your room.
These front vents direct cool air from the cooler into the room.
To change the fan speed, grab the knob and turn it . Rotate the knob until it points to the speed you want.  Follow the hand shown on screen as an example.
Moving onto step3 for Speed Adjustment.   This is the fan speed control knob.  You can turn it to Low, Medium, or High to adjust the airflow.
Grab a vent and tilt it up or down.  This changes the direction in which the air flows.
Step 4.   These are the air vents at the front of the cooler.  You can adjust them to change the direction of the airflow.
As we select the Pump mode, Water is drawn from the tank at the bottom of the cooler.
The water is then sent to the cooling pads inside the cooler.
As air passes through the cooling pads, cooler air flows out through the front vents.
Step 5 : Swing and Pump.   This is a Pump and Swing Control knob.  It controls the cooling and swing functions.  You can select Pump, Pump + Swing, or Swing mode.
Rotate the Knob as shown in tutorial to select Pump functionalty and Press NEXT to continue.
Now Rotate it to Swing and Pump Mode as shown in tutorial and Press NEXT to Continue.
Now Rotate it to Swing Mode as shown in tutorial and Press NEXT to Continue.
Step 5 : Swing and Pump.   Pump and Swing cools the air and moves it from side to side.   This helps spread cool air across a larger area.
Press NEXT when you are done to move to next Step.

In Swing mode, the vents move from side to side without using the cooling pump.  This helps spread normal airflow across the room when cooling is not required.  Press NEXT when you are done to move to the next step.
This is water level indicator. It shows how much water is left in the tank.
These below are wheels of the cooler. They make it easy to move the cooler from one place to another.
This is water inlet. Use the water inlet to fill the tank with water.
This is drain outlet. Use the drain outlet at the bottom to empty the water tank when needed.
Step 6 : Other Utility Parts.   Now we will move to other utility parts of the cooler.  Go through them one by one and press Finish To Finish the User Manual of cooler.
Congratulations! You have completed the Air Cooler User Guide.  Your cooler is now ready to use. Sit back, enjoy the cool breeze, and stay comfortable.
